dashboard.title: Welcome back
dashboard.sub: The real exam: {questions} questions · {minutes} minutes · pass mark {pass}%.
dashboard.reviewOne: 1 question to review today — you're improving!
dashboard.reviewMany: {count} questions to review today — you're improving!
dashboard.reviewText: Going back to your mistakes is the quickest way to fix them for good. It only takes a few minutes.
dashboard.startText: {title}. Answer a few questions: every answer gets you closer to the exam.
dashboard.focusText: {title}: {answered} of {total} questions done. Keep going, you're on the right track!
dashboard.mockAgainTitle: Great work — keep your exam rhythm going!
dashboard.mockText: Put it all together with a mock exam: {questions} questions in {minutes} minutes, just like the real one.
dashboard.mockCardText: Random questions, weighted like the real JSE-40-01.
dashboard.mockActiveText: You have a mock exam in progress. Pick up where you left off.
dashboard.projectsFirst: Build a real mini-website step by step. Start with {name}.
dashboard.projectsNext: Ready for the next one? Start {name}.
dashboard.projectsAllText: Amazing work. You can open any of them again to review it or show it off.
dashboard.projectsSoonText: Guided HTML, CSS and JavaScript projects are coming soon.

notFound.text: This page doesn't exist, but there's plenty to practise. Go to the Dashboard.

progress.subSaved: Your progress is saved in this browser. Keep a copy safe or move it to another computer.
progress.subNotSaved: Keep a copy of your progress safe or move it to another computer.
progress.noStorage: Your browser isn't letting us save progress, so it's only kept while this tab is open. Export a copy before you close it and import it next time.
progress.hintEmpty: Answer your first questions in Practice by topic and your progress will show up here.
progress.backupText: Download a file with everything you've done. You can import it later in this or another browser. Importing a file replaces the progress saved here.
progress.resetText: Clear your answers, mistakes, exercises, mock exams and projects in this browser. Export a copy first if you might want it back.
progress.resetConfirm: Reset all your progress? This can't be undone.
progress.exported: Done! Your progress file has been downloaded. Keep it somewhere safe.
progress.imported: Progress imported. Welcome back — pick up right where you left off!
progress.resetDone: Fresh start! Your progress has been reset. You've got this.
progress.errorJson: That file couldn't be read. Choose the .json file you exported from JSE Practice.
progress.errorFormat: That file isn't a JSE Practice progress file. Choose the .json file you exported from this app.
progress.errorInvalid: That progress file looks damaged, so nothing was changed. Try another copy.
progress.errorNewer: That file comes from a newer version of JSE Practice. Reload the page and try again.

practice.sub: Pick a section and practise at your own pace. After every answer you'll see why it's right or wrong.
practice.loadError: The questions couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.
practice.empty: The questions for this section are on their way. Meanwhile, try another section in Practice by topic.
practice.noSection: This section doesn't exist. See all the topics.
practice.doneText: You answered {answered} questions and got {correct} right. Every question you practise makes the exam easier — keep it up!
practice.doneTextOne: You answered 1 question and got {correct} right. Every question you practise makes the exam easier — keep it up!
practice.doneNone: You skipped every question this time. Whenever you're ready, give them a go — the explanations will help you along.
practice.trickyText: The classic tricks of the JSE-40-01, from every section. Learn to spot them here and they won't catch you in the exam.

theory.loadError: The theory couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.
theory.empty: The theory sheet for section {n} is on its way. Meanwhile, keep practising in Practice by topic.
theory.trapsSub: The tricks that exam questions on this section like to play. Read them slowly and run the examples.
theory.ctaOne: 1 question with a trap from this section
theory.ctaMany: {count} questions with traps from this section
theory.ctaText: Put the traps you've just read to the test. Each explanation shows you how to spot them.
theory.ctaSoon: The tricky questions for this section are on their way
theory.ctaOtherText: Meanwhile, you can try the ones from the other sections.
theory.ctaNoneText: Meanwhile, the examples on this page are a great way to practise: change them and run them again.
theory.nextText: Practise the whole section. Every answer comes with its explanation.
theory.nextSoon: The practice questions for this section are on their way.

tricky.theoryLink: Want to see this trap and others like it explained? Read the exam traps of section {n}.
tricky.emptyAll: The tricky questions are on their way. Meanwhile, keep practising in Practice by topic.
tricky.emptySection: This section doesn't have tricky questions yet. Try the ones from the other sections.
tricky.emptySectionNone: The tricky questions for section {n} are on their way. Meanwhile, keep practising in Practice by topic.
tricky.doneText: You answered {answered} tricky questions and got {correct} right. Every trap you spot now is one less surprise in the exam — well done!
tricky.doneTextOne: You answered 1 tricky question and got {correct} right. Every trap you spot now is one less surprise in the exam — well done!
tricky.doneNone: You skipped every question this time. Whenever you're ready, give them a go — the explanations show you how each trap works.

question.hint: Choose your answer and press Check answer. The explanation will appear here.
question.wrongMsg: Not quite — you'll get it next time!
question.courseHint: review this lesson if you want to go deeper

srs.added: Added to My mistakes. It'll come back tomorrow so you can nail it.
srs.reset: No worries: it'll come back tomorrow. Every review makes it stick a bit more.
srs.promoted: {count} of {total} right in a row! See you again in {days} days.
srs.mastered: Mastered! {total} right in a row: this one is yours.

mistakes.sub: Questions you get wrong come back after 1, 3 and 7 days. Get one right {total} times in a row and it's mastered.
mistakes.dueText: It only takes a few minutes. Each right answer brings a question closer to mastered.
mistakes.nextDays: Your next review is in {days} days:
mistakes.allMasteredText: Every question you missed is now mastered. Keep practising to find new ones to learn from.
mistakes.emptyText: When you miss a question in Practice by topic, it'll come back here so you can master it. Mistakes are how you learn!
mistakes.howRight: Get it right on its day
mistakes.howRightText: It comes back in {first} days, then in {second} days.
mistakes.howMasteredText: After {total} right answers in a row. If you miss it again, it simply starts over.
mistakes.nothingDue: There's nothing to review right now. Great job keeping up!
mistakes.doneText: You reviewed {answered} questions and got {correct} right. Reviewing your mistakes is one of the best ways to prepare for the exam — well done!
mistakes.doneTextOne: You reviewed 1 question and got {correct} right. Reviewing your mistakes is one of the best ways to prepare for the exam — well done!
mistakes.doneNone: You skipped every question this time. They'll be here whenever you're ready.

run.title: Run this code
run.intro: Change anything you like and press Run (or Ctrl+Enter) to see what happens. The code runs in a safe sandbox, so you can't break anything.
run.gapNote: The gap is filled in with the correct answer. Try the other options too!
run.dialogNote: No windows open here: prompt() answers {inputs}, as the user does in the question, and confirm() answers true (OK).
run.dialogNoteCancel: No windows open here: prompt() answers null (Cancel) and confirm() answers true (OK).
run.idle: Press Run to see the output here.
run.empty: The code ran without printing anything.
run.timeout: Stopped after {seconds} seconds because the code was still running. Is there a loop that never ends?
run.truncated: Only the first {n} lines are shown.
run.unsupported: This browser couldn't run the code. Try a recent version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

editor.help: <kbd>Tab</kbd> indents the code. To leave the editor with the keyboard, press <kbd>Esc</kbd> and then <kbd>Tab</kbd>. <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> runs it.

exercises.sub: Write real code and check it against the tests. Hints and the solution are there whenever you need them.
exercises.loadError: The exercises couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.
exercises.empty: The exercises for this section are on their way. Meanwhile, try another section in Coding exercises.
exercises.conceptsCard: This section is about concepts — practise it with the questions and the theory sheet.
exercises.conceptsText: There are no coding exercises here on purpose: this part of the exam checks ideas and terms. Practise it with the questions and the theory sheet — you'll find plenty of code to write in the other sections!
exercises.noSection: This section doesn't exist. See all the exercises.
exercises.solutionNote: There's more than one right answer: if your code passes all the tests, it's correct.
exercises.resultSolved: All tests passed — exercise solved! Great work. Take a look at the solution to see other ways to do it.
exercises.resultSome: {passed} of {total} tests passed — you're close! Look at the test that fails, change your code and check again.
exercises.resultNone: Not there yet — keep going! Read the first test, compare what you get with what's expected and try again. A hint can help.
exercises.resultError: Your code has an error. The console shows where it is. Fix it and check again — errors are part of programming!
exercises.resultCallError: Calling your function gave an error. Read the message under each test: is the function name spelled exactly as in the task?
exercises.resultTimeout: Your code took more than {seconds} seconds. Is there a loop that never ends? Check its condition and try again.
exercises.alreadySolved: You've already solved this exercise. Practise it again whenever you like!

mock.sub: A full JSE-40-01 simulation, so the real exam feels familiar.
mock.ruleQuestions: questions from all six sections, many with code to read
mock.rulePass: to pass, just like the real exam
mock.ruleFeedback: No feedback until the end: you'll see your score when you finish.
mock.ruleFlag: Not sure about a question? Flag it for review and come back to it before you finish.
mock.ruleTimer: The timer keeps running if you leave the page, so find a quiet moment first.
mock.readyText: Give yourself {minutes} minutes without interruptions. The timer starts as soon as you press the button.
mock.startError: The mock exam couldn't be prepared. Reload the page and try again.
mock.activeTitle: You have a mock exam in progress
mock.activeText: Time left: {time}. Pick up where you left off.
mock.soonTitle: Mock exams are on their way
mock.soonText: We're adding the exam questions. In the meantime, every topic you practise gets you closer.
mock.seeResultLabel: See the result of mock exam {n}
mock.missingQuestion: This question is no longer available. Move on to the next one.
mock.noFeedback: No feedback during the exam — results and explanations appear at the end, just like the real test.
mock.warnOne: 1 minute left. Take a last look at your flagged questions.
mock.confirmText: When you finish you'll see your score, and you won't be able to change your answers.
mock.timeUp: Time's up! Your answers were submitted automatically.
mock.passedText: You reached the pass mark. Keep taking mock exams so the real one feels routine.
mock.awayText: You're {count} questions away from the pass mark. Every mock exam gets you closer!
mock.awayTextOne: You're just 1 question away from the pass mark. Every mock exam gets you closer!
mock.toReview: The {count} questions you got wrong are now in My mistakes, ready to review tomorrow.
mock.toReviewOne: The question you got wrong is now in My mistakes, ready to review tomorrow.
mock.resultMissing: We couldn't find that mock exam. It may still be in progress, or your progress may have been reset.
mock.focusText: Focus next on {section} ({stat}). It's below the {pass}% pass mark, so a little practice there will make the biggest difference.
mock.allPassText: Every section reached the {pass}% pass mark. Brilliant! To keep improving, give {section} ({stat}) another look.
mock.perfectText: A perfect score in every section! Keep it up with another mock exam whenever you like.
mock.compareFirst: This is your first mock exam, so now you have a score to beat. The next one will show you how much you've improved.
mock.compareUp: {count} more correct answers than in mock exam {n} ({from}% → {to}%). You're improving!
mock.compareUpOne: 1 more correct answer than in mock exam {n} ({from}% → {to}%). You're improving!
mock.compareUpPercent: Up from {from}% in mock exam {n} to {to}% now. You're improving!
mock.compareSame: Same score as in mock exam {n} ({to}%). Steady results are a great base, and reviewing today's mistakes is your next step up.
mock.compareDownImproved: You improved in {sections} compared with mock exam {n}. Overall, last time went a little better ({from}%): every exam is different, and reviewing today's mistakes is the quickest way to bounce back.
mock.compareDown: Mock exam {n} went a little better ({from}%). Every exam is different, and reviewing today's mistakes is the quickest way to bounce back.
mock.bySectionLegend: Green: at or above {pass}% · Purple: focus next
mock.reviewIntro: Open a question to see your answer, the correct one, why the other options are wrong and the full explanation.
mock.emptyNote: You didn't answer this one. Here's the correct answer, so you'll be ready next time.
mock.noneRight: No correct answers this time. Open the ones to review: every explanation brings you closer.
mock.noneToReview: Nothing to review: you got every question right!

projects.heading: Course review projects
projects.sub: Build real mini-websites step by step: first the HTML, then the CSS, then the JavaScript.
projects.notExam: Not part of the JSE exam — practice for everything you learned in the course.
projects.loadError: The projects couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.
projects.empty: The guided projects are on their way. Meanwhile, keep preparing for the exam in Practice by topic.
projects.noneProgress: No project in progress right now. Choose one in “All” and start with its HTML!
projects.noneDone: No completed projects yet — your first one is closer than you think.
projects.noneNew: You've started every project. Great work!

brief.notFound: This project isn't ready yet. See all the projects.
brief.reqTitle: Requirements — what your project must contain
brief.progressDone: Project completed — well done! Your website passed the final checklist.

workspace.notFound: This step doesn't exist. Go back to the project brief.
workspace.editorHelp: <kbd>Tab</kbd> indents the code. To leave the editor with the keyboard, press <kbd>Esc</kbd> and then <kbd>Tab</kbd>. <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> checks the step.
workspace.consoleEmpty: Nothing here yet. Use console.log() in script.js to see values here.
workspace.resultPass: All checks passed — great work! Continue with step {n}.
workspace.resultPassLast: All checks passed — great work! Every step is done: now look at your whole website in the final checklist.
workspace.resultSome: {passed} of {total} checks passed — you're nearly there! Fix the ones marked “Not yet” and check again.
workspace.resultNone: No check passed yet. Read “What to do” again and open the hint if you need it — you've got this!
workspace.resultTimeout: The check took too long. Is there a loop that never ends? Fix it and check again.

result.headSub: Final result — your HTML + CSS + JS together
result.blocked: Your browser blocked the new tab. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
result.noteDone: Everything on the checklist works: your HTML, CSS and JavaScript are working together. Download your project and keep it!
result.noteChanged: With your latest changes, {passed} of {total} items pass. You can go back to the editor and fix them — the project still counts as completed.
result.noteSome: {passed} of {total} ready — you're almost there! Go back to the editor, finish the items marked “Not yet” and come back here.
result.noteNone: Nothing on the checklist is ready yet. Work through the steps in the editor and you'll see your website come together here.
result.noteTimeout: The check took too long. Is there a loop that never ends? Fix it in the editor and come back.
result.downloaded: Your project has been downloaded as {file}.
result.compareTitle: Your project and the reference solution
result.compareNote: There are many correct ways to build a website, so yours doesn't have to be identical. Use the reference to get ideas or to get unstuck.
